label: Bible Study
prompt: And that from a child thou hast known the holy _____, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verse: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
note: Timothy learned the scriptures early — Paul credits his grandmother Lois and mother Eunice.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good _____, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
verse: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
note: After a day of uproar in Jerusalem, the Lord stood by Paul that night: cheer up — Rome is next.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, _____; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
verse: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
note: 'Hosanna' is a Hebrew cry meaning 'save now' — the Palm Sunday crowd shouting a prayer and a welcome at once.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is _____ come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
verse: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
note: The Bible's last invitation: the Spirit, the bride and every hearer say come — and the water is free.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And her prophets have daubed them with _____ morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
verse: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
note: False prophets 'daubed' a crumbling wall with 'untempered morter' — whitewash that won't hold. Yes, the KJV spells it morter.
